content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Jammu
content_sections.text: The notice describes AIIMS Jammu as an Institute of National Importance and one of the new AIIMS under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY), set up by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India. Its stated aims are correcting regional imbalance in quality tertiary level healthcare and attaining self-sufficiency in graduate, postgraduate and higher medical education and training. Applications are invited from Indian citizens and persons registered as Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) cardholders under Section 7A of the Citizenship Act, 1955, as permissible under the applicable Act/Rules.

content_sections.heading: Post-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 4 posts in total. The category-wise break-up is not printed. The notice prints the age limit only as the numbers above. It does not print an age cut-off date or any age relaxation. AIIMS Jammu reserves the right to increase or decrease the posts or not to fill any post without giving a reason.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Applicants must have the essential qualification and experience up to the last date of online submission (14 December 2026). Passing the qualifying exam or completing the experience after that date leads to cancellation of candidature. Only experience gained after the essential qualification is counted, and only experience in recognised organisations or institutions is considered. Essential qualifications, either of the following: A recognized medical qualification included in the I or II Schedule or Part II of the 3rd Schedule (other than the licentiate qualifications) to the Indian Medical Council Act 1956, with 5 years' experience in Blood Bank with component separator. Holders of qualifications included in Part II of the 3rd Schedule should fulfil the conditions in sub-section (3) of Section 13 of the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956. OR M.D. in Blood Transfusion Medicine with 1 year experience in Blood Bank with component separator during the PG course. Essential: A degree in relevant stream of AYUSH from a Recognized University/Statutory State Board/Council/Faculty of Indian Medicine or equivalent recognized under the relevant council. Enrolment on the Central Register of that stream in Central or State Register of Indian Medicine. Experience: 3 years clinical and/or teaching experience in a recognized hospital/teaching institution. Desirable: a postgraduate degree in relevant stream of AYUSH from a Recognized University/Statutory/State/Board/Council/Faculty of Indian Medicine. Educational qualification: M.A. / M.Sc. in Psychology with M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology. Experience: at least 2 years' experience in Child & Adolescence mental health. Desirable: Ph.D. in Clinical Psychology from recognized University / Institution. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post. If a candidate claims an equivalent qualification, the order or letter showing the authority (with number and date) that treats it as equivalent must be uploaded. The Competent Authority of AIIMS Jammu decides equivalence and its decision is final.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Level 11 for Blood Transfusion Officer and Level 10 for Medical Officer Ayush and Child Psychologist, as per the 7th CPC. Rupee amounts are not printed. All posts carry the usual allowances admissible to Central Government employees of similar status at Samba (Vijaypur), UT of J&K. The posts are whole time, and private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited. Probation: two years for all posts. Pension: employees of AIIMS are governed by the New Pension Scheme under the Ministry of Finance, Department of Economic Affairs (ECB & PR Division) Notification No. 5/7/2003-ECB&PR dated 22.12.2003. Joining time: 30 days from the issue of the appointment letter. An extension is considered only in exceptional cases with the approval of the Competent Authority. A candidate selected against more than one post who joins one post and opts to change will not be allowed to change. Accommodation: residential accommodation is provided in principle, but it may not be possible soon after joining because of paucity of accommodation in the campus. If none is provided, House Rent Allowance as admissible to Central Government servants of similar status at Vijaypur (Samba/UT of J&K) will be provided as per rules.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee, once paid, is not refunded under any circumstances. A candidate applying for more than one post must fill a separate online form and deposit the fee separately with each application. Applications without the prescribed fee are summarily rejected. The notice does not state the payment mode.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on performance in the Interview. A written test or screening, based on objective criteria, may be held to shortlist applicants to be called for interview. The decision of the Competent Authority on shortlisting is final and binding on all candidates. The interview date is shown as tentative and "To be notified separately". The venue is Academic Block, 6th Floor, AIIMS, Vijaypur, Jammu. The test/interview schedule will be mailed to provisionally eligible candidates on their registered e-mail ID. Shortlisted candidates called for interview must bring the printout of the online application and a set of self-attested photocopies of all documents uploaded online, along with the originals of the certificates. Failure to produce them on the day leads to cancellation of candidature and the candidate will not be allowed to appear for interview.

content_sections.text: Register and apply online only, in the prescribed format, on the AIIMS Jammu website https://www.aiimsjammu.edu.in . Online registration is open from 14 November 2026 to 14 December 2026 up to 5.00 PM. Fill in a correct and active e-mail ID, because the Institute sends all correspondence by e-mail. For more than one post, submit a separate online form and fee for each post. Upload documents in support of every claim (date of birth, experience in the sequence of the application, essential qualification), separately against each claim, scanned in 200 dpi grey scale within the prescribed file size. Check that the photo and signature are clearly visible in the preview. An application is rejected if they are small or not visible. Pay the application fee of Rs. 1500/- and submit the application. Send self-attested copies of all relevant certificates (age, qualification, experience), proof of payment, NOC and other testimonials, along with the printout of the online application, so that they reach the following address on or before 21 December 2026: Registrar, Academic Block, 6th Floor, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Vijaypur, Jammu, 181134. Failure to submit the hard copy by 21 December 2026 leads to cancellation of the candidature. For technical problems in submitting the online application, write to [email protected] . For recruitment-related queries, write to [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Annexure – I of the notice lists the enclosures to be attached with the hard copy: Print out of application duly signed on each page Birth certificate / age proof Matriculation certificate Intermediate / +2 certificate Graduation mark sheets and degree certificate Post-graduation mark sheets and degree certificate Post PG qualification (D.M., M.Phil, Ph.D.) certificate Experience certificate(s), relieving orders etc. Registration certificate with Medical Council of India, statutory body etc. Application fee payment receipt No Objection Certificate from present employer, if applicable Any other relevant documents The notice states that the 10th/Matriculation certificate (or mark sheet) showing date of birth is the proof of age. Pay slip, resume, appointment letter, relieving letter and unsigned experience certificate must not be uploaded in the document upload module. An experience certificate should come from the Head of Organization and show the period ("from" to "to") and the nature of experience (administrative, teaching and/or research). A document in a language other than Hindi or English needs an English transcript attested by a Gazetted officer.

Candidature is cancelled at any stage if the educational qualification or experience is found not genuine. Inclusion in the selected list confers no right to appointment. Appointment depends on the Competent Authority being satisfied about character and antecedents. Appointment is made only if the candidate is found in good mental or bodily health after the medical examination the Institute may prescribe. Furnishing false particulars, tampering with documents, impersonation or bringing a mobile phone or communication device into the interview room can lead to disqualification, debarment, and disciplinary action for those already in government service. Any corrigendum or revision will be posted only on the official AIIMS Jammu website. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the Court of Law at Jammu, UT of J&K.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Jammu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 4 vacancies: 1 Blood Transfusion Officer, 2 Medical Officer Ayush and 1 Child Psychologist.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application is 14 December 2026, up to 5.00 PM. Online registration opens on 14 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Is a hard copy of the application required?
faq.answer: Yes. The printout of the online application with self-attested documents must reach the Registrar, AIIMS Vijaypur, Jammu on or before 21 December 2026, or the candidature is cancelled.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Child Psychologist?
faq.answer: M.A. / M.Sc. in Psychology with M.Phil. in Clinical Psychology and at least 2 years' experience in Child & Adolescence mental health. A Ph.D. in Clinical Psychology is desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for each post?
faq.answer: The notice prints 40 for Blood Transfusion Officer and 35 each for Medical Officer Ayush and Child Psychologist. No cut-off date or relaxation is printed.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1500/- and is non-refundable. A separate fee is payable with each application when applying for more than one post.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Selection is based on performance in the interview. A written test or screening may be held to shortlist applicants for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay for these posts?
faq.answer: Blood Transfusion Officer is at Pay Level 11, and Medical Officer Ayush and Child Psychologist are at Pay Level 10, as per the 7th CPC. Usual allowances for Central Government employees at Samba (Vijaypur) apply.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes. A separate online form must be filled, and the application fee deposited separately, for each post.

faq.question: Q10. Is a No Objection Certificate needed?
faq.answer: An NOC from the present employer is mandatory for regular candidates working in Government, Semi or Quasi Government, Government enterprises or Government funded autonomous institutions. Without it they will not be interviewed.
